top_violation_types.title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

top_violation_types.title: Immunizations-Documentation of immunizations may be official record or photocopy that includes - Child's name and date of birth (26 TAC §746.623(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child's file was review and the immunizations in file was a picture and not a copy or the original.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Out of the eight children's files reviewed, six were missing a date of admission.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.5317)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detectors require a battery change.
